governance: Sealed-set discipline: question+SQL pairs are generated deterministically, sandbox-verified, hashed and frozen BEFORE any annotator call. Annotation labels remain machine-adjudicated SILVER, never human gold.

generation.novelty_rule: ALL template families must be NEW: no reuse of the 17 template_family ids used by the 91 dev-visible candidates; new families target tables/operations not covered by dev templates (e.g. reserve_requirements_da, dispatch_da window aggregation, branches ratings, generator_costs ranking, load_timeseries_da peaks, SimBench lines/transformers/loads/switches).
generation.target_size: ~85 items (45 RTS + 40 SimBench), deterministic template instantiation
generation.verification: every gold SQL executes in the read-only sandbox; answer_shape (columns + column_count) registered from actual execution; items with errors are dropped and logged, never silently fixed
generation.freeze_artifact: runs/ma_stage3/sealed_questions.jsonl + sealed_manifest.json (per-item sha256 + set-level sha256, custodian='annotation-pipeline', no-leakage declaration)

annotation.models_and_params: unchanged from MA v1.1 (A=DeepSeek, B=Gemini, C=gpt-5.4 via Cloubic; temperature 0; max_tokens 1024)
annotation.negative_controls: 30 blinded negatives generated from the sealed items by generate_negative_controls.py rules (same 5 families, balanced, seed 20260807); annotators cannot distinguish them

metrics: v1.1 metrics + negative detection rate; sealed-set results are reported separately from the dev-visible 91
